scope: single cells were transferred directly to a glass injection vial with 3 µL PBS. Cells were subjected to freeze-thaw cycles three times by placing the vials on dry ice and thawing briefly on ice. After each thaw cycle, cells were sonicated for 3 min in an ultrasonic cold-water bath.
